comment: M20 mirror rooms: twisted versions of real places. Fight rooms on a floor become one of these with mirrorChance (higher for places the player visited this week or the story touched via storyFlags). 'theme' picks the look and layouts (data/rooms/themes.json); 'text' is said on entering.

rooms.name: The Frozen Deli
rooms.text: Sausages hang from the ceiling like icicles. The bell over the door rings on its own, slowly.

rooms.name: The Breathing Hall
rooms.text: The hallway goes on too long. The lockers open and close, in and out, like lungs.

rooms.name: The Furnace Maze
rooms.text: The forge has grown into a maze of anvils and chimneys. Every wall is warm.

rooms.name: The Endless Ward
rooms.text: Corridor, door, corridor, door. The number on every room is the same.

rooms.name: The Upside Gym
rooms.text: The bleachers hang from the ceiling. The scoreboard counts down to something.

rooms.name: The Silent Library
rooms.text: Every book is open to the same page. The page is blank until you look away.
